# CV PDFs Directory

This directory should contain the following PDF files for the floating action button downloads:

- `academic-cv.pdf` - Academic CV in PDF format
- `creative-cv.pdf` - Creative CV in PDF format

These files will be accessible via the floating CV dropdown button in the top right of the site.

## To Add Your PDFs:

1. Export/save your CVs as PDF files
2. Name them exactly as listed above
3. Place them in this `/assets/pdfs/` directory
4. The floating button dropdown will automatically link to them
